All 3 tests pass when run explicitly. Note that plain `node --test` (no args) doesn't pick up `.spec.js` files by default — its built-in glob only matches `*.test.js`-style names — so to run this you'll need `node --test src/num.spec.js` or `node --test "**/*.spec.js"` (or add a `test` script to package.json with that pattern).

Added `src/num.spec.js` with three cases for `clamp`: below range (`-5` → `0`), inside range (`5` → `5`), and above range (`15` → `10`). `src/num.js` untouched.
